> CodePi Design System v2.0.0 — legacy specification maintained for compatibility. For current entry see README.md.

# Motion

Fast 150ms, normal 220ms; prefer opacity/transform transitions, no motion required to understand a state. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Loading should not flash, trap focus or block accessible status updates. Avoid parallax and large auto-playing effects by default.


## Global loading

See [LOADING_SYSTEM.md](LOADING_SYSTEM.md) for animation timing, reduced-motion fallback, variants and accessibility.
